In this paper, we explore to automate the major overhead. Typically, automated proof in software verification is a conditional generation task from the specification to the proof, involving reasoning capabilities.
outputs: Formal proofs in Isabelle for software verification lemmas

We employ accuracy at k trials as the performance indicator, denoted as ACC#k. Specifically, the subject LLM independently generates k proofs using temperature sampling and nucleus (top-p) sampling. If at least one of the k trials is successfully verified, ACC#k for the corresponding lemma is 1; otherwise, it is 0.
